purpose: Source of truth for CI test architecture to prevent test command flapping and ensure consistent test behavior across gates

package_test_command.environment: TEST_WITH_DB not set (defaults to testing behavior controlled by config)

package_test_ci_command.environment: TEST_WITH_DB set via shell or CI environment
package_test_ci_command.purpose: CI-grade testing with serialized workers for safety

npm_test.purpose: Non-database test suite (fast, no external dependencies)

npm_run_test:ci.purpose: CI-grade testing with serialized execution (safer for concurrent CI environments)
npm_run_test:ci.note: Actual behavior depends on TEST_WITH_DB environment variable at runtime

ci_yml_build_and_test.include_tests: all database-dependent + all non-database tests (comprehensive gate)
ci_yml_build_and_test.purpose: Comprehensive blocking gate: type check → prisma validate → build → full test suite
ci_yml_build_and_test.enforcement: All checks must pass to merge

ci_cd_foundations_test.include_tests: non-database tests only (excludes phase tests, runtime-proof tests)
ci_cd_foundations_test.purpose: Fast non-database gate: validates core logic without external dependencies

test_with_db_false.database_initialization: skipped (TEST_WITH_DB check in vitest-global-setup.ts and vitest.setup.ts)
test_with_db_false.behavior: Tests that require database are not executed; DB initialization is not attempted

test_with_db_true.behavior: All tests including database-dependent tests are executed; test fails if DB unavailable
test_with_db_true.enforcement: DATABASE_URL must be valid and PostgreSQL must be accessible

TEST_WITH_DB.when_not_set: defaults to false (backward compatible with non-DB testing in development)

when_false.behavior: Non-database tests only; database initialization skipped

when_true.behavior: All tests including database-dependent; database initialization required

TEST_WITH_DB.error_if_true_but_db_unavailable: Test suite fails fast (intentional: DB required)
TEST_WITH_DB.error_if_false_but_test_needs_db: Test is excluded by config (intentional: isolation enforced)

ci_gate_stability_rules.command_stability: ci.yml build-and-test command must remain 'npm run test:ci'; ci-cd-foundations must remain 'npm test'
ci_gate_stability_rules.reason: Package scripts are the stable interface; workflows reference scripts, not raw vitest commands
ci_gate_stability_rules.violation_detector: If command changes without documented architectural reason, revert immediately
ci_gate_stability_rules.test_with_db_stability: ci.yml must have TEST_WITH_DB=true; ci-cd-foundations must have TEST_WITH_DB=false

allowed: set +e only to capture exit codes with explicit set -e restoration

ci_gate_stability_rules.proof_of_real_testing: Each gate must allow tests to run fully and fail visibly if tests fail

rationale: The test architecture separates database-dependent testing from non-database testing to enable: (1) fast non-DB gates in ci-cd-foundations (no external resource requirement), (2) comprehensive DB-inclusive testing in ci.yml (proof that all database interactions work), (3) predictable CI behavior regardless of which workflow runs first, (4) developer clarity: TEST_WITH_DB=false means 'no database needed'; TEST_WITH_DB=true means 'database required and will be used', (5) prevention of fake green: all test failures are visible and blocking unless explicitly designed to be non-blocking. The contract enforces that ci.yml is the comprehensive gate (with database) and ci-cd-foundations is the fast gate (without database), and both are real blocking gates with no hidden errors.
